title: चतुर्थोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira dedicates the hall with a great feast for ten thousand Brahmins and enters it. Sages and kings from every land gather there to wait upon him, and Gandharvas and apsarases entertain the assembly.
summary.kn: ಹತ್ತು ಸಾವಿರ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರಿಗೆ ಮಹಾಭೋಜನ ನೀಡಿ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಸಭಾಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ ದೇಶಗಳ ಋಷಿಗಳೂ ರಾಜರೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸೇವಿಸಲು ಸೇರುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಗಂಧರ್ವರು ಅಪ್ಸರೆಯರು ಸಭೆಯನ್ನು ರಂಜಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर दस हज़ार ब्राह्मणों को भोज देकर सभा में प्रवेश करते हैं। हर देश के ऋषि और राजा उनकी सेवा में एकत्र होते हैं, और गन्धर्व तथा अप्सराएँ सभा का मनोरंजन करते हैं।
summary.te: పదివేల మంది బ్రాహ్మణులకు మహాభోజనం ఇచ్చి యుధిష్ఠిరుడు సభాప్రవేశం చేస్తాడు. అన్ని దేశాల ఋషులు, రాజులు అతనిని సేవించడానికి చేరుతారు, గంధర్వులు అప్సరసలు సభను అలరిస్తారు.
summary.ta: பத்தாயிரம் அந்தணர்களுக்குப் பெருவிருந்தளித்து யுதிஷ்டிரர் ஸபையில் நுழைகிறார். எல்லா நாட்டு முனிவர்களும் மன்னர்களும் அவரைச் சேவிக்கக் கூட, கந்தர்வர்களும் அப்ஸரஸ்களும் ஸபையை மகிழ்விக்கிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: പതിനായിരം ബ്രാഹ്മണർക്കുള്ള വലിയ സദ്യയോടെ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ മണ്ഡപം സമർപ്പിച്ച് അതിൽ പ്രവേശിക്കുന്നു. ലോകത്തിന്റെ എല്ലാ ഭാഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നുമുള്ള ഋഷിമാരും രാജാക്കന്മാരും അദ്ദേഹത്തെ സേവിക്കാൻ ഒത്തുകൂടുന്നു; ഗന്ധർവന്മാരും അപ്സരസ്സുകളും സദസ്സിനെ രസിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.4; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः प्रवेशनं चक्रे तस्यां राजा युधिष्ठिरः ।
अयुतं भोजयामास ब्राह्मणानां नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira held the entrance ceremony in that hall, and the ruler fed ten thousand Brahmins.

verses.text:
घृतपायसेन मधुना भक्ष्यैर्मूलफलैस्तथा ।
अहतैश्चैव वासोभिर्माल्यैरुच्चावचैरपि ॥

meaning.en: He fed them with ghee and milk-rice, honey, cakes, roots and fruits, and gave them fresh clothes and garlands of many kinds.

verses.text:
ददौ तेभ्यः सहस्राणि गवां प्रत्येकशः प्रभुः ।
पुण्याहघोषस्तत्रासीद्दिवस्पृगिव भारत ॥

meaning.en: The lord gave each of them thousands of cows; and the cry of blessing rose as if touching the sky, O Bharata.

verses.text:
वादित्रैर्विविधैर्गीतैर्गन्धैरुच्चावचैरपि ।
पूजयित्वा कुरुश्रेष्ठो दैवतानि निवेश्य च ॥

meaning.en: With instruments of many kinds, songs and perfumes of every sort, the best of the Kurus honored the deities and installed them.

verses.text:
तत्र मल्ला नटा झल्लाः सूता वैतालिकास्तथा ।
उपतस्थुर्महात्मानं सप्तरात्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: There wrestlers, actors, dancers, bards and praise-singers attended the great Yudhishthira for seven nights.

verses.text:
तथा स कृत्वा पूजां तां भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवः ।
तस्यां सभायां रम्यायां रेमे शक्रो यथा दिवि ॥

meaning.en: After holding that festival with his brothers, the Pandava delighted in that lovely hall like Shakra in heaven.

verses.text:
सभायामृषयस्तस्यां पाण्डवैः सह आसते ।
आसां चक्रुर्नरेन्द्राश्च नानादेशसमागताः ॥

meaning.en: In that hall sages sat with the Pandavas, and kings who had come from many lands sat there as well.

verses.text:
असितो देवलः सत्यः सर्पमाली महाशिराः ।
अर्वावसुः सुमित्रश्च मैत्रेयः शुनको बलिः ॥

meaning.en: There were Asita, Devala, Satya, Sarpamali, Mahashiras, Arvavasu, Sumitra, Maitreya, Shunaka and Bali.

verses.text:
बको दाल्भ्यः स्थूलशिराः कृष्णद्वैपायनः शुकः ।
सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिः पैलो व्यासशिष्यास्तथा वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Baka, Dalbhya, Sthulashiras, Krishna Dvaipayana, Shuka, Sumantu, Jaimini and Paila, Vyasa's pupils, and I myself as well.

verses.text:
तित्तिरिर्याज्ञवल्क्यश्च ससुतो लोमहर्षणः ।
अप्सुहोम्यश्च धौम्यश्च आणीमाण्डव्यकौशिकौ ॥

meaning.en: Tittiri, Yajnavalkya, Lomaharshana with his son, Apsuhomya, Dhaumya, Animandavya and Kaushika.

verses.text:
दामोष्णीषस्त्रैवणिश्च पर्णादो घटजानुकः ।
मौञ्जायनो वायुभक्षः पाराशर्यश्च सारिकौ ॥

meaning.en: Damoshnisha, Traivani, Parnada, Ghatajanuka, Maunjayana, Vayubhaksha, Parasharya and the two Sarikas.

verses.text:
बलवाकः शिनीवाकः सुत्यपालः कृतश्रमः ।
जातूकर्णः शिखावांश्च सुबलः पारिजातकः ॥

meaning.en: Balavaka, Shinivaka, Satyapala, Kritashrama, Jatukarna, Shikhavan, Subala and Parijataka.

verses.text:
पर्वतश्च महाभागो मार्कण्डेयस्तथा मुनिः ।
पवित्रपाणिः सावर्णिर्भालुकिर्गालवस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: The great Parvata, the sage Markandeya, Pavitrapani, Savarni, Bhaluki and Galava.

verses.text:
जङ्घाबन्धुश्च रैभ्यश्च कोपवेगश्रवा भृगुः ।
हरिबभ्रुश्च कौण्डिन्यो बभ्रुमाली सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Janghabandhu, Raibhya, Kopavega, Shrava, Bhrigu, Haribabhru, Kaundinya, Babhrumali and Sanatana.

verses.text:
कक्षीवानौशिजश्चैव नाचिकेतोऽथ गौतमः ।
पैङ्गो वराहः शुनकः शाण्डिल्यश्च महातपाः ।
कर्करो वेणुजङ्घश्च कलापः कठ एव च ॥

meaning.en: Kakshivan, Aushija, Nachiketa, Gautama, Painga, Varaha, Shunaka, the greatly ascetic Shandilya, Karkara, Venujangha, Kalapa and Katha.

verses.text:
मुनयो धर्मसहिता धृतात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः ।
एते चान्ये च बहवो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः ॥

meaning.en: These sages, devoted to dharma, steadfast and masters of their senses, and many others who had mastered the Vedas and their branches, sat there.

verses.text:
उपासते महात्मानं सभायामृषिसत्तमाः ।
कथयन्तः कथाः पुण्या धर्मज्ञाः शुचयोऽमलाः ॥

meaning.en: These great seers, knowing dharma, pure and spotless, waited on the great king in the hall, telling holy tales.

verses.text:
तथैव क्षत्रियश्रेष्ठा धर्मराजमुपासते ।
श्रीमान्महात्मा धर्मात्मा मुञ्जकेतुर्विवर्धनः ॥

meaning.en: Likewise the best of Kshatriyas attended the king of dharma: the glorious, noble and righteous Munjaketu and Vivardhana.

verses.text:
संग्रामजिद्दुर्मुखश्च उग्रसेनश्च वीर्यवान् ।
कक्षसेनः क्षितिपतिः क्षेमकश्चापराजितः ।
काम्बोजराजः कमलः कम्पनश्च महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Sangramajit, Durmukha, the mighty Ugrasena, King Kakshasena, Kshemaka the unconquered, the Kamboja king Kamala and the strong Kampana.

verses.text:
सततं कम्पयामास यवनानेक एव यः ।
यथासुरान्कालकेयान्देवो वज्रधरस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: He who alone kept the Yavanas in constant fear, as the thunderbolt-wielding god did the Kalakeya Asuras.

verses.text:
जटासुरो मद्रकान्तश्च राजा
कुन्तिः कुणिन्दश्च किरातराजः ।
तथाङ्गवङ्गौ सह पुण्ड्रकेण
पाण्ड्योड्रराजौ सह चान्ध्रकेण ॥

meaning.en: Jatasura, the king of Madraka, Kunti, Kuninda, the king of the Kiratas, also Anga and Vanga with Pundraka, the kings of Pandya and Odra with the Andhra king.

verses.text:
किरातराजः सुमना यवनाधिपतिस्तथा ।
चाणूरो देवरातश्च भोजो भीमरथश्च यः ॥

meaning.en: The Kirata king Sumana, the lord of the Yavanas, Chanura, Devarata, Bhoja, and Bhimaratha.

verses.text:
श्रुतायुधश्च कालिङ्गो जयत्सेनश्च मागधः ।
सुशर्मा चेकितानश्च सुरथोऽमित्रकर्षणः ॥

meaning.en: Shrutayudha of Kalinga, Jayatsena of Magadha, Susharma, Chekitana, Suratha, and Amitrakarshana.

verses.text:
केतुमान्वसुदानश्च वैदेहोऽथ कृतक्षणः ।
सुधर्मा चानिरुद्धश्च श्रुतायुश्च महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Ketuman, Vasudana, the king of Videha, Kritakshana, Sudharma, Aniruddha and the mighty Shrutayu.

verses.text:
अनूपराजो दुर्धर्षः क्षेमजिच्च सुदक्षिणः ।
शिशुपालः सहसुतः करूषाधिपतिस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: The unassailable king of the Anupas, Kshemajit, Sudakshina, Shishupala with his son, and the lord of the Karushas.

verses.text:
वृष्णीनां चैव दुर्धर्षाः कुमारा देवरूपिणः ।
आहुको विपृथुश्चैव गदः सारण एव च ॥

meaning.en: The unassailable princes of the Vrishnis, godlike in form: Ahuka, Viprithu, Gada and Sarana.

verses.text:
अक्रूरः कृतवर्मा च सात्यकिश्च शिनेः सुतः ।
भीष्मकोऽथाहृतिश्चैव द्युमत्सेनश्च वीर्यवान् ।
केकयाश्च महेष्वासा यज्ञसेनश्च सौमकिः ॥

meaning.en: Akrura, Kritavarma, Satyaki son of Shini, Bhishmaka, Ahriti, the mighty Dyumatsena, the great archers of the Kekayas, and Yajnasena, son of Somaka.

verses.text:
अर्जुनं चापि संश्रित्य राजपुत्रा महाबलाः ।
अशिक्षन्त धनुर्वेदं रौरवाजिनवाससः ॥

meaning.en: Mighty princes, relying on Arjuna, dressed in deerskins and bark, learned the science of the bow there.

verses.text:
तत्रैव शिक्षिता राजन्कुमारा वृष्णिनन्दनाः ।
रौक्मिणेयश्च साम्बश्च युयुधानश्च सात्यकिः ॥

meaning.en: There too, O king, Vrishni princes were trained: Rukmini's son Pradyumna, Samba, and Yuyudhana Satyaki.

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च बहवो राजानः पृथिवीपते ।
धनंजयसखा चात्र नित्यमास्ते स्म तुम्बुरुः ॥

meaning.en: These and many other kings, O lord of the earth, were present, and Tumburu, friend of Dhananjaya, always sat there.

verses.text:
चित्रसेनः सहामात्यो गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा ।
गीतवादित्रकुशलाः शम्यातालविशारदाः ॥

meaning.en: Chitrasena with his ministers, and Gandharvas and Apsarases skilled in song and instruments and in the cymbal beat of the shami wood.

verses.text:
प्रमाणेऽथ लयस्थाने किंनराः कृतनिश्रमाः ।
संचोदितास्तुम्बुरुणा गन्धर्वाः सहिता जगुः ॥

meaning.en: The Kinnaras, practiced in measure and tempo, and the Gandharvas, urged on by Tumburu, sang together.

verses.text:
गायन्ति दिव्यतानैस्ते यथान्यायं मनस्विनः ।
पाण्डुपुत्रानृषींश्चैव रमयन्त उपासते ॥

meaning.en: The high-minded ones sang in heavenly melodies, properly, delighting the sons of Pandu and the sages as they attended them.

verses.text:
तस्यां सभायामासीनाः सुव्रताः सत्यसंगराः ।
दिवीव देवा ब्रह्माणं युधिष्ठिरमुपासते ॥

meaning.en: Seated in that hall, the sages of firm vows who keep their promises attended Yudhishthira, as the gods in heaven attend Brahma.
